purpose: Reviewable Kinyarwanda draft for only the existing extracted Android resources and seven separately scoped iOS CountCopy entries.
encoding: Android english_source/rw_draft preserve the source Android outer quoting and literal backslash escapes. iOS dictionaries retain their exact keys, plural variables, format metadata, placeholder tokens/order and one/other categories.
authority_and_semantics: No native-language reviewer, legal approval, approved terminology, packaged Kinyarwanda locale or language/runtime acceptance is claimed.
Account authentication compares registered face captures. Nothing here adds OTP, liveness/PAD, camera attestation or civil-identity proof.
Uploads/private processing, matching, sharing review and separate consent purposes remain distinct. Matching never grants access; the recipient accepts the request before access.
Private backup/recovery key and fresh face are used together. No draft asks users to disclose keys or private capture material to support.
Source statements and reference/development copy are translated as source material; this draft neither approves marketing claims nor proves production behavior.

terminology_for_native_review.note: Confirm wording denotes the stored face reference/profile, not civil identity or a public profile photograph.

terminology_for_native_review.draft_choice: guhuza amafoto n’abantu / abantu bahujwe n’amafoto
terminology_for_native_review.note: Confirm recognizable face-comparison terminology without implying dating, automatic sharing or access.

terminology_for_native_review.draft_choice: isuzuma cyangwa kureba / amafoto yatoranyirijwe uyu muntu / kwemera ubusabe
terminology_for_native_review.note: Keep contributor review of exact subsets separate from recipient acceptance and current access.

terminology_for_native_review.draft_choice: kopi y’ingoboka y’ibanga / urufunguzo rwo kugarura konti
terminology_for_native_review.note: Check consistent everyday language while preserving cryptographic recovery and fresh-face requirements.

terminology_for_native_review.draft_choice: ishusho yo kureba mbere / ububiko bw’akazi / ibihuza n’amafoto
terminology_for_native_review.note: Native technical review is needed; this does not promise remote original erasure or on-device-only inference.

terminology_for_native_review.draft_choice: ibihe konti yinjiriwemo / kugenzurira igikorwa uko gihagaze / ukwiyandikisha kwishyuwe
terminology_for_native_review.note: Confirm precise terminology for active authorization, original-operation status recovery and paid recurring entitlement.
Label-style forms avoid noun-class disagreement when the unchanged placeholder itself contains a singular/plural photo phrase. Review fluency and contextual fit.

resource_entries.english_source: "Lovelies uses the system photo picker. Your library is not scanned automatically."

resource_entries.rw_draft: "Amashya abanza. Gushakisha n’aho amafoto ava bikurikizwa mu bubiko bwose bw’amafoto wemerewe kubona."

resource_entries.english_source: "Open a photo review from your gallery."
resource_entries.rw_draft: "Fungura isuzuma ry’amafoto unyuze mu bubiko bwawe bw’amafoto."

ios.scope: Seven existing English CountCopy.stringsdict entries only; separate from Android and not an installed rw.lproj.

limited_review_photo_count.NSStringLocalizedFormatKey: This review covers %#@photos@. Choose another group to review more.
Iri suzuma rireba %#@photos@ gusa. Hitamo irindi tsinda kugira ngo urebe andi.

review_notes: Review numeral placement and noun classes for every one/other branch with zero, one and many actual counts.
matched_photo_count remains a count of candidate-matched photos; it is not approved sharing or recipient access.
reviewed_photo_count means reviewed photos, not necessarily accepted/delivered/saved photos.
photo_status_count preserves %@; status text supplied from outside this dictionary still needs its own localization.
No dictionary metadata, placeholder variable or plural category is approved or changed by packaging/runtime here.

remaining_acceptance: A native Kinyarwanda reviewer checks each translation, technical terminology, tone, noun agreement and contextual accuracy against the bound English sources.
Complete extraction and review of remaining current live/reference/accessibility/error/status copy; this inventory is complete only for the three listed resource files.
A separately owned implementation would add reviewed rw resources and verify Android/iOS locale discovery, fallback, plural selection and all substituted status/count phrases.
Qualify zero/one/many, long names and filenames, dates/counts/transfer units, enlarged text/Dynamic Type and screen-reader behavior on the actual journeys with the runtime owner.
Recheck source hashes if default resources change; do not infer a source mismatch is covered by this draft.
